title: VI Analyzer normalized report (cross-plane input, LBA-REQ-015)
description: The normalized shape a plane's parser emits from a REAL LabVIEWCLI RunVIAnalyzer ASCII report (ni/labview-icon-editor .viancfg pattern). The tool report is FAILURE-ORIENTED: it emits a run summary of counts and enumerates ONLY the failures + testing errors per VI -- passes are never listed. So the faithful shape is a summary of counts + a findings list (findings are fail|error only; empty for a clean all-pass run). summarizeViAnalyzerReport canonicalizes this into comparable metrics + a deterministic, order-independent, locale-independent resultHash (the LBA-REQ-015 cross-plane anchor): two planes summarizing the SAME committed report produce byte-identical resultHash. Consistency: the count of fail findings MUST equal summary.failed and error findings MUST equal summary.error.

config.description: The VI Analyzer configuration identity (e.g. the .viancfg name). Carried through as summary.config; does not affect the resultHash.

summary.description: The run counts from the tool's completion line (e.g. 'VI Analyzer completed. 452 tests passed, 0 failed, ...').

findings.description: The enumerated failures + testing errors (the tool's 'Failed Tests' + 'Testing Errors' sections). EMPTY for an all-pass run. Each (viPath, test) MUST be unique.

viPath.description: Repo-relative, forward-slash, case-stable path. MUST be normalized identically cross-plane.

result.description: fail = the test flagged the VI; error = the test could not evaluate. (Passes are never enumerated.)
